text:
I can't quote it verbatim without risking misquoting statutory text, and I have no way to fetch the source here.

From memory, and not to be treated as the exact wording: Section 4(a) sets the operating requirements for permitted payment stablecoin issuers. Paragraph (1) covers 1:1 reserve backing with permitted assets, and (2) appears to cover publicly disclosed redemption policies and timely redemption. I'm not confident of that paragraph mapping, and the text may have changed between the Senate bill and the enacted version.

For the authoritative wording, use the enrolled text of the GENIUS Act (S. 1582, Public Law 119-27) on congress.gov, or the codified version once it appears in the U.S. Code. If you paste the section here, I can analyze it.
